checks: Complete frontend boots without runtime errors
Four day controls moved, not duplicated
Selecting does not receive or start
Workday start alone does not run task
Start button records task and presence
Break pauses task in same transaction

Start second pauses first; one running task
Finish sends to review, day remains open
End work is not fingerprint exit
Personal report shows timeline and totals
Clean application reload reconstructs confirmed report
Inside details uses same task/workday transaction
No optimistic state before server confirms
Lost response reuses same idempotency key

409 conflict does not override local state
Legacy API missing history does not fabricate waste
Existing task controls work without historical report
Failure handling has no uncaught exceptions
